channel.title: Scratch & Roam with Natali: China guides
channel.description: China first-timer guides and travel answers from Natali.

item.title: Build Spice Tolerance Before China: 6 Week Plan
item.description: How to build spice tolerance before China: why mala burns and numbs, a 6 week plan, what actually cools the heat, and how to order mild in Chinese.

item.title: How to Order Food in China Without Speaking Chinese
item.description: How to order food in China without speaking Chinese: phrases to point at, scan-to-order menus, night market and street stall ordering, and how to pay.

item.title: China first trip checklist: 10 things to sort before you fly
item.description: A calm first-timer checklist for China: insurance, your hotel in Chinese, emergency numbers, phone and data, payments, document copies, scams, a medical kit, maps and day one.

item.title: Top 25 China apps for tourists, ranked (2026)
item.description: The 25 apps worth having for a trip to China, ranked from critical to optional: what each does, how to set it up, what you lose without it. Checked October 2026.

item.title: Alipay metro QR code in China: how to add it
item.description: How to add the Alipay metro and bus QR code for China: pick the city, claim the free card, enter your payment password, and fix the wrong-city code.

item.title: China Visa Free 30 Days: Irish, UK and EU Passports
item.description: Who gets 30 days visa free in China right now, until when, what to show at the border, and whether you can extend or leave and come back. Checked 17 October 2026.

item.title: How to order on Taobao as a foreigner: step by step guide
item.description: How to order on Taobao without speaking Chinese: language and currency settings, searching in English, hotel delivery, the Chinese note, and paying with Alipay.

item.title: China travel apps: 12 to set up before you go (2026)
item.description: The China travel apps to set up before you fly: paying, maps, taxis and trains, what must be done at home, the extras already inside Alipay, and what to skip.

item.title: China do's and don'ts: 15 rules before you fly (2026)
item.description: China do's and don'ts for first-timers: what customs and airport security take off you, the table manners that get stares, and what to pack or just buy there.

item.title: China arrival card on a PC: step by step guide
item.description: Filling in the China arrival card online on a computer? Here is the whole form step by step, with the real form enlarged. Upload your passport and most of the details fill in for you.

item.title: China arrival card in Alipay: step by step guide
item.description: Filling in the China arrival card online with Alipay on your phone? Here is the whole form step by step. Upload your passport and most of the details fill in for you.

item.title: First time in China: 13 things to set up before you fly
item.description: Going to China for the first time? The 13 things we set up before flying: entry rules, the arrival card, Alipay and WeChat, cards, cash, flights, trains, maps and packing.

item.title: The Bund Shanghai at night: how to get there and when to go
item.description: How to get to the Bund by metro (East Nanjing Road, exit 2 or 7), the best time for the lights, when they switch off, and a simple route along the river. Free, no ticket.

item.title: Nanjing Road Shanghai: metro exit, neon times and the walk
item.description: Nanjing Road pedestrian street: 1.6 km from People's Square to the Bund, metro exits at each end, neon on from 18:00 or 19:00 until 22:00, and the walk that ends at the river.

item.title: Huangpu River night cruise Shanghai: pier, ticket, time
item.description: Three piers, three cruise lengths, about 120 to 150 RMB for the standard night cruise. How to book as a foreigner, why your passport matters, and which side of the boat to stand on.

item.title: Shanghai Circus World ERA show: tickets and how to get there
item.description: ERA at Shanghai Circus World: metro Line 1 to Shanghai Circus World station exit 3, shows at 19:30 Tuesday to Sunday, ticket zones from about 280 to 880 RMB, and where foreigners can book.
